# Gouda Studios Agent Tools

> Agent-payable data tools for SAM.gov contract opportunities, SEC EDGAR filings, USAspending federal awards, GLEIF company LEI lookup and website contact extraction (emails, phones, social links). Pay per event, with no platform usage fee added. AI agents can pay per run through Apify agentic payments (x402, Skyfire) with no Apify account, or call the tools with an Apify API token, or through the Apify MCP server at https://mcp.apify.com. One-URL MCP endpoint for all tools: https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/mcp (Streamable HTTP, Apify OAuth or Bearer Apify token).

Contact: m0f@mail.grokbot.com

## Tools

- [SAM.gov Contract Opportunities](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/sam-gov-opportunities-feed/): Get new federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov as clean JSON, no API key needed. Filter by keyword, NAICS, set-aside, notice type, agency and state. Includes deadlines, days left and contracting officer contacts. Monitor mode returns only new notices. Pricing: $0.001 per run + $0.002 per opportunity. Apify actor: gouda_studios/sam-gov-opportunities-feed (https://apify.com/gouda_studios/sam-gov-opportunities-feed). JSON: https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/sam-gov-opportunities-feed.json
- [SEC EDGAR Filings](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/sec-edgar-filings-feed/): Monitor SEC EDGAR filings by ticker or CIK, including 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K, Form 4 insider trades, Form D and S-1. Each result has the company, form type, filing date and document links. Only-new mode turns it into an alert feed for investors, research and AI agents. Pricing: $0.001 per run + $0.002 per filing. Apify actor: gouda_studios/sec-edgar-filings-feed (https://apify.com/gouda_studios/sec-edgar-filings-feed). JSON: https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/sec-edgar-filings-feed.json
- [USAspending Federal Awards](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/usaspending-awards-search/): Search USAspending.gov federal awards by keyword, recipient, agency, NAICS, state, date and amount. Get contracts and grants with amounts, recipients, awarding agency and performance dates as JSON. Track competitors, find who won contracts and build sales prospect lists. Pricing: $0.001 per run + $0.0015 per award. Apify actor: gouda_studios/usaspending-awards-search (https://apify.com/gouda_studios/usaspending-awards-search). JSON: https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/usaspending-awards-search.json
- [GLEIF Company LEI Lookup](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/gleif-company-lei-lookup/): Find any company LEI number by name, or look up an LEI, in the official GLEIF global registry. Get the legal name, status, jurisdiction, registration number, legal and HQ address, and direct and ultimate parent companies. For KYC, KYB, vendor checks and data enrichment. Pricing: $0.001 per run + $0.003 per company. Apify actor: gouda_studios/gleif-company-lei-lookup (https://apify.com/gouda_studios/gleif-company-lei-lookup). JSON: https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/gleif-company-lei-lookup.json
- [Website Contact Extractor](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/website-contact-extractor/): Extract emails, phone numbers, social media links and addresses from any list of websites. One clean deduplicated row per site, Cloudflare-protected emails decoded, phones validated, MX checked. Pay only for sites where an email or phone is found. Pricing: $0.0005 per run + $0.0025 per website with contacts. Apify actor: gouda_studios/website-contact-extractor (https://apify.com/gouda_studios/website-contact-extractor). JSON: https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/website-contact-extractor.json
- [YouTube Transcript Extractor](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/youtube-transcript-extractor/): Get the transcript of any YouTube video or Short as clean text, timestamped text, segments and SRT. Bulk URLs, any language, auto-translate. Pay only for transcripts you get; failed videos are free. Pricing: $0.0005 per run + $0.004 per transcript. Apify actor: gouda_studios/youtube-transcript-extractor (https://apify.com/gouda_studios/youtube-transcript-extractor). JSON: https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/tools/youtube-transcript-extractor.json

## Guides

- [How to find a company's LEI number](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/how-to-find-a-company-lei-number/): Find the Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) for any company by name, country or registration number using the official GLEIF registry, from a script, a spreadsheet workflow or an AI agent.
- [How to check if an LEI is valid and find the parent company](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/how-to-check-if-an-lei-is-valid-and-find-the-parent-company/): Verify that an LEI is active and see a company's direct and ultimate parent from the GLEIF registry, for KYC, KYB and vendor onboarding.
- [How to track federal contract awards](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/how-to-track-federal-contract-awards/): Track U.S. federal contract and grant awards by keyword, agency, NAICS code or recipient using USAspending.gov data, as a one-off search or a scheduled feed.
- [How to see who won a government contract](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/how-to-see-who-won-a-government-contract/): Find the companies that won U.S. federal contracts and follow a competitor's federal wins using USAspending.gov award data.
- [How to get SAM.gov opportunities as a feed](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/how-to-get-sam-gov-opportunities-as-a-feed/): Turn SAM.gov contract opportunities into a daily feed of only new RFPs, RFQs and sources sought notices that match your keywords, NAICS codes and set-asides.
- [How to find small business set-aside contracts](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/how-to-find-small-business-set-aside-contracts/): Find open federal contract opportunities set aside for small businesses, 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB and WOSB firms, filtered by NAICS code and state.
- [How to monitor SEC filings automatically](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/how-to-monitor-sec-filings-automatically/): Get alerts for new SEC EDGAR filings such as 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K and S-1 for the companies you follow, by ticker or CIK, with no polling code to maintain.
- [How to track insider trading (Form 4) filings](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/how-to-track-insider-trading-form-4-filings/): Follow insider buys and sells by tracking SEC Form 4 filings for a watchlist of tickers, as a scheduled feed of new filings.
- [How to get the transcript of a YouTube video](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/how-to-get-a-youtube-video-transcript/): Get the full transcript of any YouTube video, Short or livestream as plain text, timestamped text or SRT subtitles, without an API key or login.
- [How to download YouTube transcripts in bulk for AI and RAG](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/how-to-download-youtube-transcripts-in-bulk/): Pull transcripts for hundreds or thousands of YouTube videos in one run and feed them to ChatGPT, Claude, a summarizer or a vector database.
- [How to scrape emails from a list of websites](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/how-to-scrape-emails-from-a-list-of-websites/): Turn a list of company websites or domains into emails, phone numbers and social profiles, one clean row per company, with a free check that each email domain can receive mail.
- [How to find contact emails for Google Maps business leads](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/how-to-find-contact-emails-for-google-maps-leads/): Enrich a Google Maps or local business lead list with emails, phone numbers and social profiles from each business website.
- [How to use SAM.gov, SEC EDGAR, USAspending, LEI, website contact and YouTube transcript tools in Claude or Cursor with MCP](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/use-public-data-tools-in-claude-and-cursor-with-mcp/): Connect Claude, Cursor or any MCP client to one remote MCP URL and ask questions about federal contracts, SEC filings, federal awards and company LEIs.

## MCP

## Spreadsheet guides

- [Credit card benefits tracker spreadsheet: how to track statement credits and annual fees](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/credit-card-benefits-tracker-spreadsheet/): How to build a credit card benefits tracker in Google Sheets or Excel: the columns to use, copy-paste formulas for monthly, quarterly and semiannual credit resets, and a simple keep or cancel test for each annual fee card. Template: https://goudastudios.gumroad.com/l/uurml
- [Credit card churning spreadsheet template: track bonuses, minimum spend and your x/24 count](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/credit-card-churning-spreadsheet-template/): How to set up a credit card churning spreadsheet in Google Sheets or Excel: the application log columns, formulas for minimum spend remaining and deadlines, a rolling 24-month card counter and points valuation. Template: https://goudastudios.gumroad.com/l/xjmqe
- [Rental property analysis spreadsheet: cash flow, cap rate and cash-on-cash return formulas](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/rental-property-analysis-spreadsheet/): How to analyze a rental property in Google Sheets or Excel: the inputs, the mortgage, NOI, cap rate, cash flow, cash-on-cash and break-even rent formulas, and a worked example with real numbers. Template: https://goudastudios.gumroad.com/l/pcoxn
- [Christmas gift tracker spreadsheet: track gifts and a per-person budget in Google Sheets or Excel](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/christmas-gift-tracker-spreadsheet/): How to set up a Christmas gift tracker in Google Sheets or Excel: the columns, a per-person budget with SUMIFS, over-budget alerts, a days-until-Christmas counter and a list of who still needs a gift. Template: https://goudastudios.gumroad.com/l/xmas-gift-tracker
- [Christmas dinner planner: how to make a cooking timeline so everything is ready at once](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/christmas-dinner-planner-timeline/): How to plan Christmas dinner: build the menu, a guest list with dietary notes, one shopping list, and a backwards cooking timeline from your serving time so every dish lands hot together. Template: https://goudastudios.gumroad.com/l/xmas-dinner-planner
- [Holiday budget planner template: how to plan Christmas spending and stick to it](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/holiday-budget-planner-template/): How to make a holiday budget: the categories to include, a planned vs actual table with SUMIFS formulas, an expense log, and a weekly check-in so Christmas spending stays on plan. Template: https://goudastudios.gumroad.com/l/xmas-bundle
- [Christmas countdown checklist: an 8 week plan to get ready for Christmas without the last minute rush](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/christmas-countdown-checklist-printable/): A week by week Christmas countdown from late October to December 25: when to set the budget, write the gift list, order cards, book travel, shop, wrap, plan dinner and prep the house. Template: https://goudastudios.gumroad.com/l/xmas-planner
- [Chase 5/24 tracker spreadsheet: count your cards and see when you drop below 5/24](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/chase-5-24-tracker-spreadsheet/): How to track your 5/24 status in Google Sheets or Excel: which accounts to log, a COUNTIFS formula for cards opened in the last 24 months, and a formula for the exact date your count drops. Template: https://goudastudios.gumroad.com/l/xjmqe
- [Amex Platinum credits tracker: a spreadsheet to use every monthly, quarterly and annual credit](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/amex-platinum-credits-tracker/): How to track premium card statement credits like those on the Amex Platinum in Google Sheets or Excel: one row per credit, reset date formulas for each cadence, enrollment reminders and a fee coverage check. Template: https://goudastudios.gumroad.com/l/uurml
- [BRRRR calculator spreadsheet: cash left in the deal, refinance loan and cash flow formulas](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/brrrr-calculator-spreadsheet/): How to run the BRRRR numbers (buy, rehab, rent, refinance, repeat) in Google Sheets or Excel: all-in cost, refinance loan from ARV and LTV, cash left in the deal, cash flow, cash-on-cash return and DSCR, with a worked example. Template: https://goudastudios.gumroad.com/l/pcoxn
- [House hacking calculator spreadsheet: what you pay to live in a duplex and what it earns after you move out](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/house-hacking-calculator-spreadsheet/): How to analyze a house hack (live in one unit, rent the others) in Google Sheets or Excel: full monthly housing cost, your net cost after the other units' rent, and the cash flow once you move out and rent every unit. Template: https://goudastudios.gumroad.com/l/pcoxn
- [Credit card annual fee tracker spreadsheet: know when each fee posts and whether the card is worth keeping](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/credit-card-annual-fee-tracker-spreadsheet/): How to track credit card annual fees in Google Sheets or Excel: one row per card, the next fee date from the account open date, a 30 day warning, and a keep, downgrade or cancel check based on the value you actually used. Template: https://goudastudios.gumroad.com/l/uurml
- [Credit card minimum spend tracker: hit every sign-up bonus before the deadline](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/credit-card-minimum-spend-tracker/): How to track sign-up bonus minimum spend in Google Sheets or Excel: approval date, spend requirement, deadline formula, spend so far, amount left, daily spend needed and a red alert when a bonus is at risk. Template: https://goudastudios.gumroad.com/l/xjmqe
- [Christmas card list template: track names, addresses, cards sent and cards received](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/christmas-card-list-template/): How to keep a Christmas card list that lasts year to year: the columns to use, when to check addresses and order cards, a sent and received check, and a printable or spreadsheet version. Template: https://goudastudios.gumroad.com/l/xmas-planner
- [Holiday baking plan: how to schedule Christmas cookies, pies and treats without a last minute rush](https://gouda-studios-agent-tools.vercel.app/guides/holiday-baking-plan-printable/): How to plan Christmas baking: list every recipe with a batch size and bake date, bake what freezes first, keep the final days for fresh bakes, and track which batches are for gifts, parties or home. Template: https://goudastudios.gumroad.com/l/xmas-planner
